## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `9da0cd8c3b78a1eb2e0454fffe0fa688add628c8`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md,scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs,scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs,scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs,scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs,scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/security.md (the last lane file admitted, with its ratchet row), scripts/pm/seat-record.mjs (read only through fleet-roster's import)

Inputs read: card #29242 body and both comments (the claim 6610824608, the os-dev-report 6612138226 — no ruling comment on the card beyond the body); PR #29967 body, its 11-file list and the net diff `origin/main...pr/29967` (merge-base `82f60ebb` = the merge of #29940; `origin/main` has not moved on any of the 11 files since); the check-runs on the head at 2026-11-03T18:35Z.

Check-runs on `9da0cd8c` as they stand (2026-11-03T18:35Z): success — Auto Label, Check Changeset, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · scoped · query-options erasure, Lint · scoped · slot lookup & corpus, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, Live required-set sweep, PR-body guards, Plan Test Core shards, Platform checklist gate sweep, Release section-coverage sweep, Snapshot the board, Test UI, Type Check · debt ledger, Type Check · source gates, filter; still running — Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Live half-state sweep, Test Core (1/8, 2/8), Type Check · consumer gates, Type Check · workspace; none failed. The PM self-tests and the ratchet ride the Lint lanes; the tooling self-tests lane is green, the ratchet lane (repo & tooling gates) is not yet in. Nothing below was derived from a local run.

### ① Derived judgments

- Accept-set / public surface: none. The diff touches `.claude/**` and `scripts/pm/**` only; no package, no `packages/spec/src/**`, no `exports` map. The published accept set is unchanged — right.
- Governed rules text (the face that owes this tier): four prose files under `references/`, all at their ceilings before and after. Measured on the head: `contract-review.md` 60/60, `project-forms.md` 59/59, `lanes/triage.md` 20/20, `lanes/review.md` 21 (new row at 21). Widest edited line ≤ 120 bytes in every file (review.md lines 2 and 6 are exactly 120; the pre-existing 142-byte template line 22 of contract-review.md is untouched). No raise, no cross-file move — right.
- Seat grammar widened by one bare word, in the two lists the roster pins equal: `SEAT_BARE_LANES` (mailbox-open) and `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` (check-half-states) both gain `review`. Every other reader composes from those two — `seatKey` (record-recognisers `To:` and key fields, fleet-roster mailbox slugs), `SEAT_SIGNATURE_LINE` (fleet-roster `signedSeatOf`, post-stamped, record-recognisers `readSignatureLine`). I found no third spelling of the bare-lane list left unwidened: check-half-states' `seatLane` reads only `domain:*` as a lane and classes every other seat post as `foreign` (silent), `h5SeatStickerDesync` reads the status half only, `DIRECTOR_SEAT_TITLE` is director-only. A `review#1` seat post, a `review#N` signature, a `To: review#N` doorbell and a `mailbox/LOGIN/review-N` branch all read; `domain:review` is refused as the other reserved words are — right.
- `contractReviewClaims`: the claim's side gains a third value `review`; the holder rule is unchanged in substance (earliest live claim holds; only a legacy `triage#N` claim yields). `tie` now means "a triage claim beside any non-triage claim", which is what its one consumer (check-owed-reviews `renderRow`: 「a triage claim yields」) prints — right.
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs`: the row gains `reviewSeat` / `reviewSeats`; `takerOf` gains two parameters with defaults, so the old call shape still reads as "roster unread" — right. Report-only, exit codes unchanged.
- `fleet-roster.mjs`: a `review` row's in-flight is read from `recentComments` (already fetched, 6 h window ≥ the 2 h claim lapse) against the open pulls' `head.sha` (the live `/pulls` read carries it; the fixture now does too). No new API read — the `readsFor` text says so — right.
- Ratchet: one added `CEILINGS` row and one `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin for the new file; the ratchet's own self-test ("every lane/seat job description in the tree carries a ceiling row") makes the row mandatory, and it is there — right.
- No gate, no label, no mailbox key added — matches the card's rule 8.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset`, `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`. Nothing in the diff is published by any package; the Check Changeset run is green. Clause-②: no — correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The one declared deviation (fallback = the lane's own / a sibling lane seat, ⛔ never triage; the card's rule 2 and 3 and its acceptance line say triage). Verified against `origin/main`, not against the PR body: #29686 (`2ea0fc84a0`, merged 2026-11-03 02:31Z — after the card was filed at 2026-11-02 10:13Z and before this card was dispatched at 17:24Z) put 「车道或复审席接,⛔ 非分诊」 on contract-review.md line 23, 「⛔ 分诊不再审」 on triage-duties.md line 11, and `⛔ Never triage` into `check-owed-reviews.mjs`' taker; triage-duties line 10 has the triage round counting owed heads 「只报 ⛔ 不接审」. Building triage back in as the card wrote would have reversed a landed rule and re-opened the main/branch split that #29686 closed. The deviation holds; the card's "falls back to triage" is overtaken by main, and the PR's self-test pins the no-review-seat case as the lane's own seat with no `triage` in the row. The maintainer's later word 「目前各车道都有fable,应该不需要你契约复审」 that the PR cites is not in the tree or on the card; the judgment above rests on main's rule text alone and does not need it. Answered: holds.
- `open_questions`: none declared. `security_findings: none`. Writes as declared (2 pushes, 1 relay PR create, 1 stamped comment, no MCP writes) — nothing to escalate.
- Author is `objectstack-fleet[bot]` via the relay; no out-of-relay login to name.
- Serial constraint: `lanes/triage.md` was edited only after #29940 landed; the merge-base is #29940's merge commit, so the triage.md hunk is a clean one-line change on top of it — confirmed.

### ④ Design judgment

**`lanes/review.md` (new, 21 lines)** — against the card's points 1–6 and the last lane file admitted (`lanes/security.md`, #29695): the shape matches the lane-charter convention (title line, a line-2 pointer to the duty file, section headings, one rule per ≤120-byte line). Points 1–6 are all present: seat word/number/account (line 6), effort and tier (7), mailbox via `--seat review#N` (8, and mailbox-open does take `--seat`), doorbell routing with the sibling fallback and ⛔ 非分诊 (12), mutual exclusion by the existing claim line with 「复核席之间同此」 (13), the owed list's ordering (14), delta ownership and the hand-off on an off-duty seat (15), independence with the record pair (19), the no-merge/ready/dispatch/grade/human-floor list (20), security findings by `security-findings.md` (21). The ratchet row: an added row at the landed count, headroom 0, the ruling quoted verbatim, "a NEW file, so this is an added row and no other row moves" — the same sentence and convention as the security.md row, which is how the ratchet header admits a new file (the one self-raise it allows is a cross-file move, not used here). Holds.
Should-fix S1 — the charter has no entry point from SKILL.md: #29695 gave the `security` lane a row in SKILL.md's lane table pointing at `references/lanes/security.md`; the `review` seat gets only `project-forms.md`'s seat-word line (复核 = `review.md`). A session invoked `pm-dispatch 复核` finds the charter only through project-forms. SKILL.md is at headroom 0, so this is an in-place edit of an existing row (the `director` or `triage` arg row), not a raise. Not a must-fix: the card did not list SKILL.md and the seat word resolves through project-forms.

**`contract-review.md` (60/60)** — line 5's heading points at the charter; line 23 reads 「复核席先接,车道次之,⛔ 非分诊」 at 119 bytes (the 、 and the full stop paid for it); lines 21, 25, 26, 53 switch 复审席 → 复核席. The claim template (line 27) and the 2-hour lapse (line 28) that `record-recognisers.mjs` pins are untouched. Consistent with review.md line 14 and with `takerOf`. Holds.

**`project-forms.md` (59/59)** — line 15 now names three seat words; line 40's doorbell row names 复核席. Note (no fix owed): line 15 spells 总监 = `lanes/director.md` but 分诊 = `triage.md` and 复核 = `review.md`; line 16 says the rest follow `lanes/<lane>.md`, so it reads, but the mixed spelling is a byte-budget artefact.

**`lanes/triage.md` (20/20)** — line 15 「契约复核(归复核席,`review.md`)」 replaces 「PASS/FAIL 归车道」; triage still does not push for contract reviews and now names where they go. Consistent with triage-duties lines 10–11 on main. Holds.

**`check-owed-reviews.mjs`** — `reviewSeatsOf` reads `parseSeat` rows (fleet-roster's parser; a title `[PM seat] review · seat 1 — 🟢 login` yields lane `review`, seat 1 — read in the cited code). `takerOf`: hand-off first; review seated ⇒ 「a review seat (review#1, review#2) first」, the lane joining at `waited ≥ 2 × 60` min (waited is minutes from the head commit, so "(b) + one further round" = 120 min, the card's wording), the lane-gone branch naming the next seat; review stood-down or absent ⇒ the lane's own seat with 「(no review seat seated)」; roster unread ⇒ the pre-PR wording. The self-test's new battery covers seated-first, the further round, no review seat (never `triage` in the row), stood-down ≠ seated, lane gone, roster unread, hand-off precedence, a review-side live claim ⇒ HELD, and the printed row. Three earlier assertions were retargeted from 「or a review seat」 to 「(no review seat seated)」, which is the right reading of a roster with no review post. The tooling self-tests lane is green. Holds.
Should-fix S2 — independence is not read into the taker. review.md line 19 bars a review seat from a PR its own account dispatched or implemented, but `takerOf` names every seated review seat and makes the lane wait a further round before it may join. With one review seat seated on the dispatching account, the row names only a seat that may not take it, and the lane is told to wait 60 more minutes for nobody. The row has the review seats' accounts (`parseSeat` gives `account`) and the PR's attribution login (the `claude-projects-attribution` line in the body, or the card claim's `Account:`); dropping a barred seat from `reviewSeats` — and treating "none left" as "no review seat seated" — would make the printed routing match the rule. Not a must-fix: the list is report-only and the seat applies the rule itself.

**`fleet-roster.mjs` + fixture** — `reviewClaims` keys by `signedSeatOf` (first-line signature, `review#N` only), reads the claim with `readContractReviewClaim`, lapses it with `contractReviewClaimLapse` from the comment's `created_at` against the pull's current `head.sha`, skips closed pulls and pulls without a sha. The row: `claims !== null` short-circuits account sharing and card in-flight, so a review row never reads `= seat N` and never carries a card; the claimed pull's `updated_at` and the signed-comment time feed last activity. The fixture's three review-signed claims (live on the current head, expired at 2 h, on a moved head) and the expected rendered row are the right scenarios. One imprecision, no fix owed: a claim stays "live" for up to 2 h after the same seat posts its record (the lapse reads head and age only, not the record), so a just-reviewed PR can show in flight a little longer — the card asked for "in-flight = claimed heads", which this is. Holds.

**`record-recognisers.mjs`** — the side is read off the signature lane; holder = earliest non-triage live claim; three new cases (review first holds; lane first holds with no review precedence; two review seats ⇒ earliest holds, no tie). The battery count 21 → 24 matches. `readMailboxLine`'s `To:` reading goes through `seatKey`, so `To: review#N` reads without a change here. Holds.

**`mailbox-open.mjs`** — `SEAT_BARE_LANES` gains `review`; the reserved-name refusal (`domain:review`) and the `Mailbox-of: review#2 · login` read-back are tested; the pinned-equal assertion string is updated to the four words. Holds.
Should-fix S3 — the lane-word comment above `SEAT_LANE_KINDS` now reads 「The same three / four words close the seat signature's lane alternation」: the diff changed the second line to "four" and left "The same three" on the first. A one-word comment fix.

**`check-half-states.mjs`** — `SIGNATURE_LANE_SOURCE` gains `review`, the comment block above it lists the word; nothing else in the file enumerates bare lanes. Holds.

**`check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs`** — judged under review.md above. Holds.

**`fleet-roster.fixture.json`** — the seat post, the mailbox pull, two head shas, three claims; the shapes match what the live read returns (`issue_url`, `created_at`, `head.sha`). Holds.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: S1 (SKILL.md entry point for the `review` lane), S2 (bar the dispatching/implementing account's review seat in `takerOf`), S3 (the "three / four" comment in mailbox-open).

Implemented-by: `claude/project-thread-ypvuqe`
Reviewed-by: `session_01WGufzhd2Ad9ANGTyAMW7pH`

**VERDICT: PASS**

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `6e66dd44401c2886e89311a8d9f5874a5b771b78`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/contract-review.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/review.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/triage.md,.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/project-forms.md,scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs,scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs,scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.fixture.json,scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs,scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs,scripts/pm/record-recognisers.mjs + scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs (the walk root, read to place SKILL.md), scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs `CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER` / `markerMatches` / `readSignatureLine` (the readers `ownAccountsOf` composes from), scripts/pm/fleet-roster.mjs `parseSeat` (the `account` the bar compares), .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md

Round 1 (delta) after the round-0 record 6612385105 on `9da0cd8c`. The delta is two commits: the merge of `origin/main` at `3b8c724c` (`911fc606`, conflict-free; main moved on none of the PR's 12 files between `82f60ebb` and `3b8c724c`, and has not moved on them since) and `6e66dd44`, which takes S1, S2 and S3. Read as `git diff 9da0cd8c 6e66dd44 -- <the PR's files>` beside the net diff `origin/main...pr/29967`: the delta touches `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` (1 row), `scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs` (+61/−13) and `scripts/pm/mailbox-open.mjs` (1 comment line); the other nine files are byte-identical to the round-0 head. SKILL.md is new to the `hits` set, so it is judged in full below.

Check-runs on `6e66dd44` as they stand (2026-11-03T18:51Z): success — Auto Label, Check PR Size, Dogfood Regression Gate, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint · docs & code guards, Live required-set sweep, PR-body guards (×2), Platform checklist gate sweep, Release section-coverage sweep, Snapshot the board, Test UI, filter; still running — Lint · CI release & engine gates, Lint · ESLint, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · scoped (query-options erasure, slot lookup & corpus, tooling self-tests), Live half-state sweep, Plan Test Core shards, Type Check (consumer gates, debt ledger, source gates, workspace); none failed. Check Changeset has not re-reported on this head yet (green on `9da0cd8c`; the delta adds nothing a changeset could cover). The PM self-tests and both ratchets ride the Lint lanes still running; nothing below was derived from a local run.

### ① Derived judgments

This is round 1 after 6612385105. Round 0's ① stands for the nine unchanged files; the delta adds:

- SKILL.md (governed, at its 319-line ceiling): one row of the 域车道 table edited in place — the `security` row's first cell becomes `security` · `review`(车道,无 `domain:*` 标签) and the cell ends 「。复核席 `review#N` 见 `references/lanes/review.md`」. Measured on the head: 319/319 lines (net 0), the edited row 333 bytes against the 341-byte `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` pin (the widest rows stay the two 341-byte survivors), file bytes 31749 → 31817 (+68). The skills token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`) walks `skills/` only — the published catalog — so `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` is outside it; the PR body's 「the skills token ratchet stays within its ceiling」 is true but vacuous, and the binding gates are the line ratchet and the row pin, both of which hold. No script parses that table's first column (grep over `scripts/` and `.github/` finds only ratchet comments naming the 域车道 table), so a two-word cell breaks no reader. Right.
- `check-owed-reviews.mjs`: the row gains `reviewBarred`; `reviewSeatsOf` gains a second parameter with a default (`new Set()`), so the round-0 call shape still reads as "nobody barred"; `reviewSeat` gains a fifth state `barred`; `takerOf` gains the `barred` branch; the printed row gains `(barred …)`. Three names are newly imported from check-half-states — `CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER`, `markerMatches`, `readSignatureLine` — all exported there already (lines 1213, 1464, 1314 on the head); no new API read: the card comments were already fetched for the record-on-card reading (readSnapshot lines 517–521). Report-only, exits unchanged. Right.
- `mailbox-open.mjs`: the S3 comment now reads 「The same / four words close …」 across the line break. Right.
- Accept-set / public surface: still none; `Clause-②: no`, `skip-changeset` — unchanged.

### ② Semver level

Unchanged from round 0: nothing published; `Clause-②: no` is correct.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The round-0 deviation (fallback = the lane's own / sibling seat, never triage) is unchanged in the tree. The maintainer's quoted word is now located: it is not on #19357 or #18917 (every comment on both posts read, 116 and 75), but it is quoted verbatim on the triage seat post #6015, comment 6592722947 (2026-11-03T01:11Z): 「目前各车道都有fable，应该不需要你契约复审」, posted before #29686 landed the rule at 02:31Z. The premise now has both legs — the landed rule text on main and the quoted word — and holds.
- The refreshed PR body matches the tree: SKILL.md 319/319 and the row at 333 bytes (measured), check-owed-reviews 82 cases in 10 batteries (78 + the 4 new assertions in the `review-seat first` battery, 10 → 14), mailbox-open's S3, three pushes (618cdf4f, 9da0cd8c, 6e66dd44), no MCP write. One imprecision, not a flag: 「the skills token ratchet stays within its ceiling」 — the file is outside that ratchet's walk (①).
- No `open_questions`, `security_findings: none`. Nothing to escalate.

### ④ Design judgment

**SKILL.md (S1)** — against the card's acceptance (the charter must be reachable) and the last lane file admitted (security.md got a SKILL.md row): the review seat now has an entry point from the skill itself, folded into the one row that already carries the other label-less lane, under the same 「车道,无 `domain:*` 标签」 parenthetical. It is a pointer, not a restatement (the charter stays in review.md). In place, net 0 lines, within the row pin. Holds.

**check-owed-reviews.mjs (S2)** — `ownAccountsOf(pull)`: the implementing account is the `github_login` of the body's `claude-projects-attribution` JSON (regex to the first `}` on the line, parsed with `JSON.parse` under try/catch — the relay writes a flat one-line object, so the regex is sufficient; a malformed object names no account); the dispatching account is the signer (`readSignatureLine(...).account`) of every card comment matching `CLAIM_COMMENT_MARKER` (`/^\s*>?\s*Claim(?:ed)?\s*:/mi`, through `markerMatches`). Logins are lowercased on both sides, and `parseSeat`'s `account` (the 🟢 login or the first assignee) is what the bar compares; a review post with no account is never barred. `reviewSeatsOf` splits seated review seats into `seated` and `barred`: any unbarred seat ⇒ `seated` (named first, the barred ones listed), every seated seat barred ⇒ `barred` ⇒ the lane's own seat at once, no further round, no triage. Four new assertions cover the read (attribution + claim signer, non-claim and unsigned comments, unreadable attribution, empty pull), the only seat on the implementing account, a seat on the dispatching account beside a third-account seat, and the lane-gone/no-account cases. This is what round 0's S2 asked for. Holds.
Failure modes read in the code:
- Card comments unreadable (`pull.cardComments = null`, readSnapshot line 520): the guard yields no dispatching account, so a review seat on the dispatching account is named as if free; the read failure is in `gaps` and the sweep prints INCOMPLETE, but the row itself says `seated`. Should-fix S4 (minor): when `pull.cardComments === null`, read the bar as unjudged — `reviewSeat: 'unknown'`-style wording on the row — the way an unread roster already reads for the lane seat, rather than printing a seat the rule may bar. Not a must-fix: the gap is printed and the seat applies review.md line 19 itself.
- Over-barring: a card comment that quotes a `> Claim:` line (a triage audit, a round record) bars its signer's account too. Harmless direction — it withholds a name, never adds one — and no fix owed.
- A hand-off that names a barred review seat still wins in `takerOf` (hand-off precedence is unchanged). That is the writer's error, not the reader's, and the seat refuses under review.md line 19; no fix owed.
- Multiple `Claim:` comments across re-dispatches bar every signer — conservative and right.

**mailbox-open.mjs (S3)** — the comment reads correctly. Holds.

**The nine unchanged files** — byte-identical to `9da0cd8c`; round 0's ④ stands.

Must-fix: none. Should-fix: S4 (an unreadable card-comment read should mark the independence bar unjudged on the row rather than print the seat as free). Round 0's S1, S2 and S3 are taken.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：新增复核席章程 `lanes/review.md`。`review#N` 席坐在其他有 fable 的账号上，专职做契约复审。车道的 `Request: contract-review` 改敲复核席信箱；没有复核席在座时，由车道自己的兄弟席接，⛔ 不回分诊。同一 head 的认领沿用 `Contract-review-claim:`，先贴的持有。复核席不审本账号派发或实现的 PR，也不做 merge、ready、派发或定级。脚本侧：`check-owed-reviews.mjs` 优先点名复核席（同账号的回避），`fleet-roster.mjs` 把复核席列成行。
- 为什么改：你问「契约复审我想分拆到其他账户，怎么处理。」后裁定「选 B，立卡」。和卡面不同的一点：卡上写分诊兜底，但 main 已改为「车道或复审席接，⛔ 非分诊」，你 11-03 也说过「目前各车道都有fable,应该不需要你契约复审」，所以兜底是车道兄弟席。
- 风险与回滚：现有规则文字都是原位改写，不加行、不升上限；新文件按新增文件规则加一行上限（21）。不加门禁、标签或信箱键。没有复核席坐席前，行为和今天一样。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`lanes/review.md` 全文，`contract-review.md` 第 5、23 行，`check-owed-reviews.mjs` 的 `takerOf` / `reviewSeatsOf`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/pm/check-owed-reviews.mjs --self-test` 显示 82 cases pass；`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` 绿。
- 需要你做的：无。要开复核席时，在其他账号上照 `lanes/review.md` 开座位贴和信箱即可。Tier S，席位按复审 PASS 落地。
